SPECIFICATION FOR 
RENEWABLE LOCK SCREW LOCATING 



PINS

o

(0 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and otiier requirements of renewable lock screw locating pins to 
be fitted in jigs and fixtures for locating or positioning tlie job for use with press fitted headed and 
headless linear bushes conforming to IS:666 (Part 2)-1972 'Specification for jig bushes; Part 2 Renew- 
able drill bushes (second revisionY alongwith locl<ing screws. 

Note — These pins are preferred to be used on heavy jigs and fixtures where replacement and fixing of pins can 
easily be done from top side only without tumbling upside down and where due to more base thickness of jigs and fix- 
tures proper surface area of bottom side for fixing these pins is not available. 

2. Types 

a) Type A — Round shaped renewable lock screw locating pin. 

b) Type B — Diamond shaped renewable lock screw locating pin. 

Note — Generally one of each type of pins is used in a pair and fitted in a jig or fixture. Selection of pins is 
done to suit the sizes and tolerances of two locating holes of work piece, which are reamed accurately and centre 
distance of which is toleranced to close limit. Diamond pins take variation of distance between the centres of two 
locating holes of workpiece, and accordingly diamond pin is fixed to give the diamond contacts at right angle to 
the line joining the centres of two locating pins to prevent radial movement of workplece about the axis of round 
locating pin ( see 3.4 ). 

3. Dimensions 

3.1 Dimensions for renewable lock screw locating pins shall be as given in Table 1. 

3.2 Dimensions for press fit liner bush (headed or headless) shall be according to Table 2 of IS:666 
(Part 2)-1972. 

3.3 Dimensions for locking screws shall be according to Table 3 of IS : 666 (Part 2)-1972. 

3.4 Mounting dimensions for renewable lock screw locating pins shall be as given below;

4. Tolerance — The diameter D of the renewable lock screw locating pins (see 3.4) shall be toleranced 
to suit the requirements. 

5. Material and Hardness — Suitable case hardening steel having hardness 550 to 650 HV to a case 
depth of 0-4 to 0*6 mm. 

6. Designation — A renewable lock screw locating pin of round shape, Type A having Z?== 10 mm shall 
be designated as: 



Renewable Lock Screw Locating Pin A10 IS; 11613. 



7. Finish — The renewable lock screw locating pins shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other 
defects. 



8. Preservation and Packing 



8.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to renewable lock screw locating pins. 

8.2 The renewable lock screw locating pins shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 



9. Marking 



9.1 Each renewable lock screw locating pin shall be marked at an appropriate place with type, size 
and manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 



9.2 ISI Certification MarA//?flr— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

EXPLA N ATO R Y NOTE 

This standard has been prepared based upon the experience of our industry. It was felt necessary 
to reduce the variety and rationalise the sizes. The sizes covered in this standard are generally used 
in the industry.
